title: Jesus didn’t just come once.
paragraphs:
Jesus didn’t just come once.
He promised He will come again.

Two thousand years ago, the world watched a man crucified on a cross. Many thought it was the end of the story. But three days later the tomb was empty, death was defeated, and hope entered the world forever.
Before He ascended into heaven, Jesus made a promise that still echoes through history:

This isn’t just a religious idea or a symbolic message. The Bible declares that one day the sky will open, the trumpet will sound, and the King of Kings will return. The same Jesus who walked on water, healed the broken, and rose from the grave will return in glory.
The real question isn’t if He will return.
The real question is are we ready when He does?
Life is short. Eternity is real. And grace is still available today.
If you’re breathing, it’s not too late to turn to Him.
Repent. Believe the gospel. Follow Jesus.
Because the next chapter of history will not be written by kings, governments, or nations.
It will be written by the return of Christ.
If you believe Jesus is coming back, share this and let the world know.
